source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school half-yearly examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2016-2017', 'Std. : VIII', 'Subject : Mathematics', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2 Hrs.+15mins. reading time'; examYear 2017 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). durationMinutes 135 = 2 h + 15 min as printed. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images; fractions, powers, roots and degree signs were rebuilt inline from the images. Section A [40 marks] is compulsory (Q1-Q4); Section B [40 marks] says 'Answer any four questions' and prints Q5-Q10. Q4 a) and Q9 b) have no printed marks (marks 0, flagged). Q2 b) and Q7 b) print '[3x2]' and are kept as single 6-mark entries. Constructions (Q5 b, Q10 b) have no matching chapter (chapter null). No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
